narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Spiral
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as the US-Iran conflict escalates beyond a controlled tit-for-tat, with Iran shooting down a US Apache and threatening regional war expansion. The Hormuz blockade persists through Q3 2026 per EIA, while Israel opens a two-front escalation, driving safe-haven flows into commodities and out of equities.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude oil and gold; short S&P 500 and emerging market equities; overweight US Treasuries.

narratives.title: Commodity Supply Shock Realignment
narratives.summary: Capital is rotating into energy and defense commodities as the SPR release is revealed as bullish pre-positioning, not bearish supply injection. The Hormuz blockade structurally tightens oil markets, with Kuwait seeking bypass pipelines and EIA raising WTI forecasts, while Ukraine deep strikes on Russian logistics amplify supply risks.
narratives.trade_implication: Long crude oil futures and energy sector ETFs; short consumer discretionary; consider long uranium and agricultural commodities.

narratives.title: Diplomatic Mirage vs. Market Reality
narratives.summary: Capital is pricing a fragile status quo despite White House claims of Iran deal progress, as contradictory signals (IDF readiness, Kuwait bypass talks) suggest diplomatic off-ramps are unreliable. The equity selloff is driven by algorithmic stop-loss cascades rather than genuine repricing, leaving markets vulnerable to further downside if escalation continues.
narratives.trade_implication: Hedge equity portfolios with VIX calls or put spreads; underperform long-duration bonds; consider shorting high-beta tech stocks.
